description_en: Retrieves the list of databases authorized for the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 获取当前RAM用户已授权的数据库列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-operation-databases --instance-id bastionhost-cn-tl32wdd --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOperationDatabases

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page for a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.  
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. Default value: 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave the PageSize parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size
